rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw schedule labels the valuation columns as dollar-denominated amortized cost and fair value. Table 35 row 4 explicitly shows dollar signs on amortized cost and fair value, and row 7 shows a foreign-currency par loan whose cost remains in the same schedule valuation column while the EUR amount is only a parenthetical instrument/FV detail. The flagged value is therefore a USD unit alias/normalization issue in the check, not a non-USD cost data error.
